articles.title: Hong Kong Hosts Major Asia-Pacific Finance Meeting Today
articles.summary: Hong Kong is welcoming finance ministers and senior officials from 21 Asia-Pacific economies for a two-day meeting starting today. Known as the APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting, the event is being held at the Convention Centre in Wan Chai. Hong Kong's Financial Secretary said the city is the perfect place to bring regional leaders together to discuss how economies can work more closely, especially during uncertain times around the world. The meeting is also a warm-up for the bigger APEC Leaders' Summit, which will take place in Shenzhen next month. Over 500 officials and representatives are expected to attend.

lv1: What is the name of the big meeting happening in Hong Kong today? (今天在香港舉行的大型會議叫什麼名字？)
How many Asia-Pacific economies are taking part in the APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting? (有多少個亞太經濟體參與今次APEC財長會議？)
lv2: Why do you think it is important for finance ministers from different countries to meet and talk together? (你認為不同國家的財政部長聚在一起開會，為什麼重要？)
Why might Hong Kong be chosen as the host city for this important international meeting? (為什麼香港會被選為這個重要國際會議的主辦城市？)
lv3: The article says regional cooperation is becoming more important due to geopolitical tensions. Do you think countries should always cooperate on economic issues, even if they have political disagreements? Why or why not? (文章指地緣政治緊張令區域合作更加重要。你認為各國即使存在政治分歧，也應該在經濟問題上合作嗎？為什麼？)

Some people say hosting international events like APEC brings great benefits to a city, while others argue the costs and disruptions are not worth it. What is your view? (有人認為主辦APEC等國際活動為城市帶來巨大利益，也有人認為費用和干擾不值得。你的看法是什麼？)

articles.title: Scientists Find Forest Soils Are Getting Better at Absorbing a Harmful Gas
articles.summary: A surprising discovery about forests has excited scientists around the world. A study lasting up to 24 years found that the soil under some forests is getting much better at soaking up methane, a powerful greenhouse gas that contributes to climate change. On average, the amount of methane absorbed by these soils grows by about three percent each year. This is especially happening as temperatures rise and less rain falls — the opposite of what many scientists predicted. The finding challenges old ideas about how forests respond to climate change, and suggests that some forest soils might actually help slow down global warming.

lv1: What harmful gas are forest soils getting better at absorbing, according to the study? (根據研究，森林土壤正在更好地吸收哪種有害氣體？)
How many years did the scientists study the forest soils? (科學家研究森林土壤多少年？)
lv2: Why is it significant that forest soils can absorb more methane as temperatures rise? (為什麼隨著氣溫上升，森林土壤能吸收更多甲烷這件事很重要？)
How does this discovery challenge what scientists previously believed about climate change and forests? (這個發現如何推翻科學家以前對氣候變化和森林的認識？)
lv3: If forests can help absorb greenhouse gases, should governments prioritise protecting forests over building new towns and roads? Who should make these decisions, and how? (如果森林有助吸收溫室氣體，政府應否優先保護森林，而非興建新市鎮和道路？這些決定應由誰來制定，如何制定？)

This study covered only some forests. Do you think we should change global climate policies based on findings from a limited number of locations? What are the risks of doing so? (這項研究只涵蓋部分森林。你認為我們應該根據有限地點的研究結果來改變全球氣候政策嗎？這樣做有什麼風險？)

articles.title: 本港6歲女童感染甲型流感情況危殆　今季兒童嚴重個案累計24宗
articles.summary: 香港出現新一宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案。一名原本健康的6歲女童於本月15日因發燒入院，其後確診感染甲型流感，情況危殆。當局公布，本季至今已錄得24宗兒童嚴重流感個案，情況令人關注。醫生提醒家長應注意子女的健康狀況，若出現發燒、咳嗽等徵狀應盡早求醫，並鼓勵市民及早接種流感疫苗，保護自己及家人。

lv1: 感染甲型流感的女童今年幾歲？
本港今個流感季節，兒童嚴重個案累計有多少宗？
lv2: 為什麼醫生建議孩子出現發燒症狀時應盡快就醫，而不是在家休息等待康復？
接種流感疫苗如何幫助保護個人及社區，減少嚴重個案的出現？
lv3: 香港政府應否立法強制兒童每年接種流感疫苗？這樣做有什麼好處和壞處？
有人認為個人有權自行決定是否接種疫苗，也有人認為為了保護整個社會，政府應加強推廣甚至強制接種。你支持哪個立場？請解釋你的理由。

articles.title: 颱風「薔琵」最快今日形成　AI氣象模型預測或北轉移向日本
articles.summary: 氣象部門預報，一個熱帶低氣壓正在關島以東海域發展，最快今日（20日）加強成為今年第30號颱風，名為「薔琵」。有預測指「薔琵」可能進一步增強為超強颱風。最新AI氣象模型估算，颱風路徑可能向北偏轉，移向日本方向，對華南地區影響相對較小。天文台預料香港下周天氣大致天晴及乾燥。市民應繼續留意天文台的最新天氣消息。

lv1: 今次颱風的名字叫什麼？
根據天文台的預報，香港下星期的天氣會怎樣？
lv2: 為什麼AI氣象模型對颱風路徑的預測對市民和政府很重要？
超強颱風和普通颱風有什麼分別？超強颱風會帶來哪些危險？
lv3: 近年天氣預報越來越多採用人工智能（AI）技術。你認為AI的氣象預測比傳統方法更可靠嗎？這對氣象部門的工作有什麼影響？
氣候變化被指令颱風變得更強烈。政府、企業和個人各自應承擔什麼責任，以減少氣候變化帶來的影響？
